text: Lila's housewarming is Saturday 14 Nov from 7pm, new flat in Leith. She said bring nothing but I'll take a plant anyway.
isaac interview at the council fri at 10am. second round. hes bricking it
Lwazi has a final on Sunday 25th at half 2, they're playing Rovers away. Must text him good luck Sunday morning.
Farid and his wife Noor are hosting a curry night on the 7th, he's doing the lamb, she's doing everything else apparently

So I was talking to Caitlin after choir and she's got the solo in the Christmas concert, which is 12/12 at 7.30 at St Mary's. Her mum is flying over from Cork for it. She said she's fine but she kept fiddling with her sleeves the whole time so I think she's quite nervous actually. Should send her a message the night before.
Kevin didn't get the Barclays job. Gutted for him. Check in with him at the weekend
giulia - gluten free, hates coriander. noted for dinner
Phoebe ran the Cardiff half yesterday, 1:52, a PB! Her boyfriend Eli did it too but pulled a hamstring at mile 9.
Mai's applied for the head of design role at her place, hears back end of the month
Vanessa's 40th was meant to be 21 Nov but it's off, her dad's in hospital again. Don't forget to ring her this week.
jasmine audition for the conservatoire 3rd of december 11am. she's been practising 5 hrs a day, wrists are killing her
Ximena mentioned her son Alfie has his first ever football match tomorrow morning, 9am kick-off. Under 7s. She's more nervous than he is lol
Chantal invited us to her engagement drinks, Fri 30th, 8pm, The Crown. Need to reply by Wednesday.
Zara got the job!!! Starts 4 January. Get her a card and a bottle of something
Dalia's dog Biscuit is having his op on Thursday morning. She's a mess about it.
Delroy - plays bass in a covers band called Second Hand News. Gig at the Fiddler's Elbow 19/11, doors 8. Said he'd put me on the list.
Kavya has a panel interview with the NHS trust on the 9th at quarter past 1, then a presentation on the 16th. Remind me to ask how the first one went on the 10th.
Aditi's sister Anika is getting married in Jaipur in Feb, the whole family's flying out on the 2nd.
Emeka said his band's playing the Brudenell next month. Into Afrobeat, Fela, all that
pick up dry cleaning tomorrow before 12

Mandla's leaving do Thursday 6pm at the Old Bell. He's off to a new job in Durban. Must chip in for the gift, Grace is collecting. He starts out there on the 1st of December, his wife and kids follow in January once school finishes. He seemed excited but also a bit wobbly about leaving his dad behind, who's not been well. Don't forget to get him a card too.
Grace mentioned her husband's 50th is 2 March and she's planning a surprise party, keep it quiet. He's been on about wanting a record player for ages
Hadiza had her viva last Tuesday at 2. Passed with minor corrections! Send congrats
Abebe's daughter is in the school play, Oliver, Wednesday and Thursday evening at 6.30. He's going both nights obviously

Long chat with Oisín on the phone tonight. He and Callum are doing the Dublin marathon on Monday the 27th, they fly out Saturday morning at 7. Training's been rough for Callum, his knee keeps playing up and he nearly pulled out last week. Oisín reckons they'll walk some of it together. Their kids are coming over with Oisín's mum to cheer at mile 20. I must ring Callum Tuesday to see how the knee held up.
Called Noor back. Her interview yesterday afternoon went ok she thinks, they said they'd let her know by Friday. Should text her Friday evening if she's heard nothing.
Vikram, Vik to everyone, has his driving test on the 18th at 8.40am. Third attempt. Don't forget to wish him luck the night before.
Dinner at Lila and Isaac's on the 22nd at 7, I'm bringing dessert
Lwazi's mum is in hospital for her hip op on 5 Dec. He's staying with her the week after.
Need to book the train to Manchester for Farid's 30th, it's 28/11, party starts 9pm
Caitlin plays the cello, grade 8, wants to join an orchestra once she's moved. Moving to Bristol in Jan.
kevin + giulia anniversary dinner sat, 10 yrs. ask kev how it went monday
Phoebe got through to the final round at Deloitte. Final interview is 11 Nov at 9am in London. She's nervous about the case study bit. Ring her the evening after to see how it went.
Mai's cat Pickle went missing on Sunday night. Came back this morning, filthy but fine.
Vanessa's niece is doing her grade 5 piano exam tomorrow afternoon, Vanessa's driving her
Quick one: Jasmine's flatmate Ximena is having a birthday thing on 31st Oct, fancy dress, at their place from 8. Need a costume.

Chantal starts her new job at the BBC on Monday, producer on the morning radio show, so 4am starts, poor thing. She was at Channel 4 for six years before this. Her girlfriend Dalia is throwing her a little celebration dinner on Saturday the 7th at 8. Text her Monday evening to see how her first day went.
Zara and her partner are doing the Great North Run 13th of September next year. Already signed up apparently, very keen.
Gym at 6.30 tomorrow morning then the dentist at 11

Dalia was telling me her brother Delroy is moving to Toronto in the spring. She's not taking it well, they're super close. Their mum is upset too. Maybe I should take her for a drink next week, she seemed really down.

Kavya's son has his first piano recital on Saturday at 2pm at the community hall, he's six. She asked if I could come along, her husband Vikram is working that weekend and her parents are away in Goa until the 20th. Said I would. Playing Twinkle Twinkle and something from Frozen apparently. Bring a little something for him after, maybe a book.
Aditi isn't going to the reunion anymore, the date clashes with her cousin's wedding on 8 May.
Emeka's pub quiz team won the league! Final was last Thursday. Must congratulate him properly.
Anika is coeliac, vegetarian too. Keep in mind for the 15th
Spoke to Mandla. His grandad passed away on Saturday, funeral is Friday at 11am in Soweto, he flies out Wednesday night. Need to send flowers to his mum and message him Thursday.
grace's daughter Aditi - no wait, Anika - anyway she got into Edinburgh for medicine!! starts september. grace was welling up telling me
Hadiza works for the Home Office, policy stuff, lives in Hackney with two flatmates. Loves climbing.

Abebe has an interview for the head chef job at Ottolenghi, Tues 10th at 3pm. He's done the trial shift already, they loved his injera. Second stage is a cook-off in front of the owners, he has to do three courses in 90 minutes. His partner Mai said he's been testing menus every night for a fortnight and the kitchen looks like a bomb hit it. Remind me to message him Tuesday evening.
Oisín's band's album launch is 20/11 at Whelan's. I'm going with Eli and Callum. Get there for 8.
Callum asked if I want to do the 5 a side tournament on the 2nd. Said yes.

Noor told me her mum's retiring on the 19th after 35 years at the hospital. There's a party for her on the Saturday, the 23rd, at the cricket club, 3pm till late. Noor's doing a speech and is terrified. I should help her with it this weekend.
Vikram plays tabla, does gigs at weddings most weekends. Wants to record an EP eventually.
Lila's partner is Dr Isaac Suzuki, the heart surgeon one. Massive F1 fan, goes to Silverstone every July. Hates small talk apparently

Isaac Evans from work, Izzy, has applied for three grad schemes, KPMG, Civil Service Fast Stream and Unilever. Fast Stream assessment centre is 2nd of December, 9am start in Newcastle. He asked if I'd do a mock interview with him beforehand, maybe the Sunday before. He's doing his MSc part time as well so he's knackered.
Farid said his brother Abebe is getting married 3rd of July. Farid's best man and freaking out about the speech already.
Applications for the Leeds job close 14/11 at midnight. Update CV this weekend.
Giulia's open mic is next Tuesday at 9. First time singing in public, she's terrified. Remind me to text her good luck on Tuesday afternoon.
Caitlin and Kevin's housewarming got cancelled, the boiler packed in. Rescheduled to sometime in December
Ximena sent the photos from Alfie's birthday party. He's turning 5 on Friday. Dropping hints about wanting a scooter. Grab one before Friday?

Note for myself: Jasmine Wright from the running club is organising the Christmas meal, it's on 12 December at 7pm at Zucco. Deposit of £20 to her by the 1st. She also mentioned her dad's 70th is the week after, the 19th, and she's doing a big family lunch at their place in Harrogate. He used to play rugby for Yorkshire apparently, still goes to every Leeds Rhinos home game.
